<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="exX0032026-09-1705-04-73" status="unreviewed">yang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3840">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3840">dan</rs></note> na re rtags kyi khyab byed du bzung pa ni sgrub bya'i chos kyi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> yin no zhes zer ba ni ma yin te | byas pas sgra mi rtag par sgrub pa na shes bya tsam byas pa'i khyab byed du bzung pas chos sa
               <lb edRef="inst:5508" n="55a2"/>thal la | 'dod na chos can sgra la shes bya mngon suM du rtogs pa sgrub byar 'gal ba yino | 'o n gang zhe na shes 'dod chos can la rtags kyi gbyar bzung pa ni sgrub bya'i chos kyi <expan>mtshan nyid</expan> zin no || de la chos can gyi steng du rtags kyis sgrub nus pa yang yod mi nus kyang go byar bzung pa yang yod de yang dag dang 'ghal ba'i chos lta bu'o ||</seg></TEI>
